# Parity Test

React components exported from Morphie's Design Agent.

    npm install
    npm run dev

- `src/design.js` holds all content, colors and layout settings.
- `src/components/` has one reusable component per section type.
- `src/styles.css` contains the design tokens (CSS custom properties) at the top;
  edit them to restyle the whole page.
- Buttons and links point at in-page anchors (`#pricing`); replace them with real URLs.
